review_description: From first contact with I Tech electrial the whole process was professional, very comprehensive detailed quote, including data sheet on panels and solar system.  two offers for two types of panels with distinct differences explained.From the time I booked the installation to the finish of the job the team were on time, tidy, considerate of my property and myself and kept me well informed.They contacted my energy company and organised the grid connection, provided all the relevant documentation,  registered the panels and system with all relevant departments/authorities.Whole process went smooth from start to finish.Would highly recommend this business.

Couldn’t be happier. Carlos and team were on time, very professional and completed the job quickly. The pricing was great and used high quality products. They showed attention to detail not only in the work but made sure everything was cleaned up perfectly. All paperwork was submitted within 24 hours and took the hassle out of having to deal with the electrical provider. I would certainly recommend ITech to install your solar

Good, fast and clean installation of the 21 panels, including removal of old panels, within 7 days of signing the contract. Good consultation on the number of panels and their layout on the roof, to maximize power generation. Good consumer support with all grid connection/upgrade organized within days. Highly recommended

This Installer really impressed me. They were Helpful. I checked their credentials and everything checked out. Local, on time. Everything installed perfectly. I sourced them from Clean Energy Website.

Wonderful service from start to finish, with a very competitive quote,which was easily changed to include our choice of Inverter,.They designed a system that has surpassed our expectations.We are producing close to double the kWh compared to the 10 year old systemthat it replaced, using the same roof space!Sincere thanks to Carlos and the team at I Tech
Best customer experience. Carlos very knowledgeable and friendly. Super fast installation and professional work

Extremely happy with Itech Electrical and would highly recommend for professionalism, price, punctuality and very tidy, everything was cleaned up and the house and my property left very tidy.  When it comes to customer service, Carlos went above and beyond to help me not just with the solar installation and meter box upgrade, but also with a couple of other electrical items I needed done.

The quoting process was initially relaxed, but when I decided to get serious they came out to the premises for a proper measure up. I really hated my experience with other pushey solar installers. These are the opposite! No 'premium care' options and other nonsense. A breath of fresh air.Carlos came out to quote, install, and connect. He is very talented, friendly and really knows his stuff.The system is working amazingly. Everything has been sorted and we are up and running.I'm recommending them to everyone I know as the quality, price, and speed of install cannot be matched.
